children.name: text
children.label: Heading
children.default: Your OMS now comes with AI agents.

children.name: tag
children.label: Heading level
children.help_text: For search engines and screen readers. Use H2 for a main section of the page. The heading always looks like the theme H2.
choices: H1 (main page heading, use once per page)

children.name: anchor_id
children.label: Anchor ID
children.help_text: Optional. Lets other links jump to this section.

name: description
label: Description
help_text: One short paragraph under the heading.
default: The HotWax Commerce Agentic AI Suite works inside the order and inventory workflows your teams already run, on live OMS data, with your team in control of every change. Agents for order routing, inventory and customer service come built in. Build your own with Agent Composer, or connect Claude and Codex through the MCP Server.

name: slides
label: Slides
help_text: Up to 3 product screens. Slide 1 shows large on the left; slides 2 and 3 stack on the right. Phones show them one under another. Use finished screenshots at 2x or larger, cropped with even padding. A slide shows once its Image is set.

children.name: title
children.label: Title
children.help_text: Short label shown above the screen.

children.name: image
children.label: Image
children.help_text: The screen on laptop and tablet. Describe what the screen shows in the alt text.

children.name: phone_image
children.label: Phone image
children.help_text: Optional. A taller crop for phones, for screens that read too small when shrunk. Leave empty to use the main image. Alt text comes from the main Image.

name: chat
label: Chat animation
help_text: Plays over slide 1 when the section scrolls into view: the Prompt is typed and sent, then the Cards appear. Made for the Circuit routing screen in slide 1. Leave Prompt empty to show slide 1 as a still image.

children.name: prompt
children.label: Prompt
children.help_text: The request typed into the chat box.
children.default: Ship orders whole. Try the warehouse first, use a store only when it has deep stock, and split only as a last resort.

children.help_text: Shown above the cards.

children.name: description
children.label: Description
children.help_text: Shown under the cards.
children.default: Review this proposal before it changes the routing screen. Send feedback to revise it, or apply it when ready.

children.name: reply
children.label: Reply after Accept
children.help_text: Circuit's answer when a visitor clicks Accept.
children.default: Changes accepted. Use Save to keep them, or Discard to revert.

children.name: discard_note
children.label: Discard note
children.help_text: Shown when a visitor clicks Discard.
children.default: Discard drops the proposal, and the routing stays as it was. For this demo, accept it.

children.name: new_chat_note
children.label: New chat note
children.help_text: Shown when a visitor clicks New chat.
children.default: New chat starts a fresh conversation with Circuit.

children.name: threads_note
children.label: Threads note
children.help_text: Shown when a visitor clicks Threads.
children.default: Threads lists your recent conversations with Circuit.

children.name: end
children.label: End card
children.help_text: Covers the chat after Accept, with a Replay button.

children.name: text
children.label: Text
children.default: Circuit turned one sentence into three routing rule changes. Your team checked them and accepted. Live routing changes only when you save.

children.name: background_color
children.label: Background color
children.help_text: Color of the stage behind the screens. The section color comes from the section's own Background setting; this module is made for a black section.
